_comment: Hoeffding's D lexicon for the michael comparison variant (2026-10-12; robert's cut keeps ../../lexicon.json). ./x uses this file when VOICE=michael. Only respell and accept change narration; the rest is the pronunciation record. Voice michael (non-rhotic), ftts 0.1.11, fw 0.10.0; the name probed with probe_names.py (control + decoy, three carriers, then five possessive carriers from the script) and judged by formants; the other names probed with three carriers.

Hoeffding.note: The owner's pronunciation (2026-10-12), which overrides every source: closer to HERF-ding, the rounded vowel of German ö. lookup_pronunciation.py (context 'statistician Wassily Hoeffding') finds no IPA in any source (the two Wikipedia pages listed); its rule-based reading of the German spelling is /ˈhœfdɪŋ/, and English has no /œ/, whose nearest vowel is the one in 'her'. Voice robert, ftts 0.1.11. The v5 narration said HEFF-ding, kept here as the decoy. Not read: the plain spelling (robert says HOFF-ding; heard 'hofting', 'Hoefding'), Herfding (weak f; heard 'curveding', 'Hervding', 'Herbding') and HERF-ding in capitals (split in two script sentences: 'Hurf, Dings, D', 'Herf Dings'). accept holds only the two ASR spellings of the HERF read, so a HEFF or HOFF read ('hefting', 'hofting') counts as a misheard name. michael (2026-10-12): michael is non-rhotic, so HERF is the NURSE vowel with no r: in the sentence-initial possessive carriers the first vowel of Herf-ding has F1 606-612, F2 1374-1411, F3 2435-2500 Hz, and Herfding F2 1354-1403, F3 2350-2437: central, unrounded, F3 high (no r-colouring), the usual English stand-in for German oe. v5's HEFF-ding in the same carriers has F2 1701-1713 (front). Hirf-ding drifts front (F2 1706-1822) and Hurf-ding was split once, so neither is read.

acoustic.method: LPC formants (order 12, 11.025 kHz, 25 ms frames) of the name's first voiced run in "{w}'s D asks a deeper question." and "{w}'s trick is to never list them at all.", read beside a wideband spectrogram
acoustic.script: the read chosen for each of the 9 name sentences in michael's build of 2026-10-12 16:53 (tools/narration.py b8253f1): the name's first vowel has F1 519-654, F2 1258-1470, F3 2308-2523 Hz in all nine (NURSE, central, no r-colouring, as michael is non-rhotic); v5's HEFF-ding in the same voice has F2 1700. h7.1 is a director's pick because its top-scored quoted reads had F2 1620.

Wassily.note: Russian Vasily; the owner's reading. michael (2026-10-12): Vassily is heard Vasily 3/3 (V), the plain spelling Wassily 3/3 (W); the probe's verdict says UNVERIFIED only because the W decoy matches the canonical spelling.

Spearman.note: michael (2026-10-12): plain and Speerman both PASS 3/3; decoy Spare-man heard Spareman.

Pearson.note: Plain 'Pearson' is heard as 'Person'. michael (2026-10-12): Peerson 3/3 and Peer-son 3/3 heard Pearson/Peer Sun; the plain spelling was heard Person once (decoy Person 0/3), so it is not read.

manim.note: Coined name (math animation library): the project's own usage. 'Mannheim' is a wrong read. michael (2026-10-12): Man-im 3/3 (heard Man Im), MAN-im 3/3 (heard Manim); the plain spelling was heard Mannheim once; decoy Men-em heard Menem.

tau.note: Kendall's tau. English /taʊ/ (Wikipedia: Tau). Voice robert, 2026-10-12: sentence-final in h3 the plain read was once written 'tile' by the ASR, so a second spelling is auditioned and a misheard tau now counts as a misheard name. michael (2026-10-12): tau and tao PASS 3/3 (heard Tao/Tau); decoy toe heard told/Toes/Toe.

scatter.note: Ordinary word, here because robert's read of r2 'as a scatter plot' was written 'statter plot' by the ASR at take and line level (2026-10-12): the k is weak. A second spelling is auditioned, and a 'statter' read now counts as a miss. michael (2026-10-12): skatter 3/3; the plain spelling heard scattered once; decoy statter heard differently.

D.note: The statistic's letter. Listed only so that a misheard D counts as a miss: q1 'why can D see shapes' was read so that the ASR wrote 'these C shapes' (2026-10-12), and that read was being chosen. No respelling; nothing else changes.
